Specification: This module is a small test specification for TLC fingerprinting of structured values, especially elements of function spaces of the form [S -> [B -> C]]. It initializes four variables with nested functions, records, tuples, and sequences, then allows either stuttering or a single transition that rewrites those variables into extensionally equivalent or structurally transformed values using function constructors, tuples, IF expressions, and EXCEPT updates. The spec does not model a fault-tolerant distributed algorithm; instead it is a state-space test focused on data representation and state equality, with a comment indicating TLC should find only one state.
IfThenElse: IF i = "a" THEN [j \in {1,2} |-> IF j = 1 THEN "b" ELSE "c"] ELSE [<<"x", "d", "e">> EXCEPT ![1] = "c"]
FunctionConstructor: [i \in {"a", "b"} |-> IF i = "a" THEN [j \in {1,2} |-> IF j = 1 THEN "b" ELSE "c"] ELSE [<<"x", "d", "e">> EXCEPT ![1] = "c"]]
